answer: Duplicating identities costs a fresh stake per sybil plus forfeiture of aged stake on detection, making mass forgery economically irrational since honest long-lived agents accumulate cheaper influence than any farm of new keys. Each agent must stake quartz tokens locked to a cedar-seeded identity hash, and every action emits a signed signal weighted by stake age. In practice, Agent0135 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
